Connect LinkedIn Ads to ChatGPT for B2B reporting

Connect LinkedIn Ads to ChatGPT to investigate campaign results without losing the context of a B2B sales cycle. Adport supplies the authorized advertising data; ChatGPT can organize the comparison and surface questions for the team. A low cost per form submission is useful information, but it does not establish qualified pipeline or closed revenue.

By AdportNovember 1, 20264 min read

In this guide

Use the Campaign Manager account as the boundaryInstall the ChatGPT connection and verify its accountSeparate platform leads from qualified opportunitiesChoose a window that fits the buying processKeep creative and audience claims tied to returned dataTurn the review into one reviewable decisionSources

Use the Campaign Manager account as the boundary

Choose the LinkedIn advertising account that owns the campaigns. Access to a company Page does not by itself establish the advertising permissions needed for every account operation. Keep the intended account in the client's Adport project, save the selection, and enable agent access.

Record the account and campaign-group identifiers used by the team. Similar campaign names across regions or business units are easy to confuse in a conversation. The LinkedIn integration guide describes provider setup and available tools. LinkedIn documents advertising, reporting, and lead-related APIs as distinct capabilities.

Install the ChatGPT connection and verify its account

Follow the ChatGPT MCP plugin guide for the hosted URL, OAuth authorization, installation, and selecting Adport in chat. Choose the project that contains this LinkedIn advertiser. Workspace permission to install a plugin does not add LinkedIn asset permissions.

Try this prompt
Use Adport to list LinkedIn advertising accounts available here. For ACCOUNT_ID, show campaign groups and campaigns where supported, including IDs and available status. Ask me to confirm the group for this review. Do not change campaigns.

Use the returned hierarchy to scope the next report. If a group-level request is unavailable, identify a supported campaign selection rather than treating the whole account as the intended business unit.

Separate platform leads from qualified opportunities

Start with one campaign objective and a definition of the lead event. An on-platform form submission, a website conversion, and an opportunity accepted by sales are different measurements. Ask ChatGPT to label each source and avoid merging them into a single conversion column.

Try this prompt
Review LinkedIn account ACCOUNT_ID for the last 30 completed days and the previous 30. Show campaign ID, objective, spend, clicks, and available lead or conversion metrics. Keep currency and metric definitions visible. Identify what CRM information would be needed to assess lead quality. Make no changes.

Do not infer CRM pipeline from advertising data alone. If you provide a separate qualified-lead report, explain how its dates and campaign identifiers match the advertising view before calculating an acquisition measure.

Choose a window that fits the buying process

B2B campaigns may need a longer observation period than a daily operational check. Write down the business's usual lead-to-opportunity lag and distinguish current delivery from downstream outcomes that are still developing. Equal-length reporting periods are a starting point, not a guarantee of a fair comparison.

Ask ChatGPT to note changes in offer, targeting, geography, tracking, or sales follow-up that the team already knows about. The report can describe an observed change; those additional facts help determine which explanation is worth testing. Avoid declaring a campaign unsuccessful on the basis of a few recent clicks.

Keep creative and audience claims tied to returned data

Use creative or audience breakdowns only when the connected tools expose the relevant fields. A campaign title mentioning a job role does not prove the demographics of the delivered impressions. The same distinction applies to geography, company size, and seniority.

A useful follow-up asks which available report would distinguish competing explanations. Keep the campaign and creative IDs with the evidence so the team can investigate in Campaign Manager if a requested dimension is unavailable. This produces a practical handoff instead of a confident summary based on assumed targeting.

Turn the review into one reviewable decision

Choose a supported action and request its preview with the exact account, entity, and intended new value. Check the budget effect and approval scope before applying it. A recommendation to investigate lead quality is not itself a reason to increase spend.

If authorization succeeds but data is absent, check the advertising role, selected project, saved accounts, reporting period, and named API error. After an approved operation, read back the platform state. The agency project guide explains how to keep this process separate across clients.
